title: Employee Department Check
scenario: Return all employees who have a department assigned. Output 'name' and 'dept_name'.
tableSchema: Employees (id INT, name VARCHAR, dept_id INT), Departments (id INT, dept_name VARCHAR)
hint: Use an INNER JOIN on the department ID.
correctQuery: SELECT e.name, d.dept_name FROM Employees e JOIN Departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE Employees (id INT, name VARCHAR, dept_id INT); CREATE TABLE Departments (id INT, dept_name VARCHAR);
